videos.title: Lam：鉬金屬化與 ALTUS Halo
watchFor: 互連縮小時需要重新評估材料，而非只縮小幾何。
鉬是此產品案例的材料；不能直接套用到銅、鈷、釕或鎢課程。
比較電阻、薄膜沉積與整合限制，分開供應商說明及自己的驗證。
watchForEn: Shrinking interconnects requires reconsidering material choices, not only geometry.
Molybdenum belongs to this product case; do not transfer it directly to copper, cobalt, ruthenium or tungsten lessons.
Compare resistance, deposition and integration constraints while separating vendor statements from your verification.
videos.scope: 本課「CMP 漿料與磨粒控制」的延伸背景。用鉬 ALD 案例比較金屬互連材料轉換；不是其他金屬的通用配方。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for CMP slurry and abrasive control. Use the molybdenum-ALD case to compare interconnect material transitions; it is not a universal recipe for other metals. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: ALTUS Halo: Ushering in the Molybdenum Era of Semiconductor Metallization
videos.originalTitle: ALTUS Halo: Ushering in the Molybdenum Era of Semiconductor Metallization
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「磨粒族群：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Abrasive populations: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「過濾取捨：建立模型」列為查證任務：去除團聚物也可能改變有效磨粒族群；濾壓差可能提示堵塞與旁通。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Filtration tradeoff: construct and analyze: Removing agglomerates can also change useful abrasive populations; Pressure drop may reveal clogging or bypass.

courses.overview: 從「CMP 漿料與磨粒控制」延伸比較化學機械平坦化、晶圓廠微污染控制：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend CMP slurry and abrasive control by comparing Chemical mechanical planarization and Microcontamination control in fabs: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: CMP 的去除率與刮傷需同時追查磨粒族群、化學活性及墊面接觸。
related.transferEn: CMP removal and scratching require joint analysis of abrasive populations, chemistry and pad contact.
related.difference: 平坦化課看晶圓高度與膜厚分布；漿料課看粒徑尾端、濃度及老化。單靠平均粒徑不能預測整片平坦度。
related.differenceEn: Planarization measures wafer height and thickness; slurry control examines particle tails, concentration and aging. Mean size alone cannot predict planarity.
practice: 畫出漿料批次到膜厚與刮傷的因果假說。
比較濾前後大粒尾端及有效磨粒濃度。
設計固定墊況的分批試驗，保留空白取樣。
practiceEn: Map hypotheses from slurry lots to thickness and scratches.
Compare large-particle tails and useful abrasive concentration before and after filtering.
Design a split with fixed pad condition and sampling blanks.
related.title: 化學機械平坦化

related.why: CMP 的去除率與刮傷需同時追查磨粒族群、化學活性及墊面接觸。
related.whyEn: CMP removal and scratching require joint analysis of abrasive populations, chemistry and pad contact.

related.transfer: 漿料粒子、取樣容器及輸送管線都是微污染追溯的一部分，需配對空白與實際製程證據。
related.transferEn: Slurry particles, sampling containers and delivery lines belong to contamination genealogy, requiring blanks and process evidence.
related.difference: CMP 有意加入磨粒，不能把所有粒子都視為污染；微污染管理須區分必要材料與非預期外來物。
related.differenceEn: CMP deliberately contains abrasives. Contamination control must distinguish useful particles from unwanted material.
practice: 列出必要磨粒、團聚物與外來顆粒三類。
比較容器空白、管路空白及真樣品。
用缺陷形貌與批次追溯評估污染假說。
practiceEn: Separate useful abrasives, agglomerates and foreign particles.
Compare container blanks, line blanks and real samples.
Evaluate contamination hypotheses with defect morphology and lot genealogy.
related.title: 晶圓廠微污染控制

courses.summary: 本課以「NIST 量測研究參考園區」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從磨粒族群、化學與機械分工到批次放行：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses NIST metrology-research reference campus as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Abrasive populations and Chemical and mechanical roles to Lot release: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
